conditions.input_read_only: Only original recording input bytes throttled; intermediate/model/probe reads and all writes counted but unthrottled.
conditions.all_read_write: All instrumented data-file reads (original input + intermediate + probe/model) share one read budget; all data writes share a separate write budget, both set to the specified rate.

timing.read_write_budgets: Independent, each per cap, shared across all processes/threads. Decimal MB/s.
timing.scope: Application logical bytes. OS file cache hits are charged. Decoded cache hits and in-RAM reuse are not disk reads. Package imports/DLL loading, filesystem metadata and benchmark instrumentation files are outside the data budget.
timing.mapped_access: Selection and whole-array coercion charge the source bytes. One-dimensional iteration preserves native memmap scalar ordering and uses bounded64KiB read-ahead accounting; consumer CPU time can satisfy delivery deadlines. Higher-dimensional iteration copies at most1MiB chunks. Same instrumentation in both conditions.
timing.timer: Public sorting API through final export plus CUDA synchronize. Imports, one scalar CUDA warmup, and KS4 probe loading/reader construction occur before the timer; data I/O budgets still apply during preparation. KS4 byte counters subtract pre-API counts. External output validation occurs after the timed counters are captured.
timing.limitations: Single run per point; logical throttling is not a physical HDD simulation. Different bandwidth points can select different clustering branches; report final-array hashes and units.
timing.order: Caps5000,50,100,200,500,1000,2000; sorters serial; alternate condition and input order between caps to reduce systematic time/order confounds.
timing.calibration_exclusions: Three attempts archived separately: cancelled unmetered raw pilot; completed scalar-meter-overhead calibration; cancelled compressed calibration while switching instrumentation. None included in valid curves.
